_doc: The pop-up registry (docs/popups.md). This file holds the plumbing's own test pop-up; each family keeps its entries in services/<family>-popups/popups.json, same shape. One entry = one tool for Skippy's chat and the agent.

popups.name: echo

text.description: Anything: it comes back exactly as it went.

mirror.description: Hand the attached picture or sound back instead of the JSON.

popups.description: The pop-up plumbing's test service: returns its arguments (and the size of any attached file) as JSON, or the attached file itself with mirror. Only to prove the path works.
